name: light_init_thermal_glow_pool
description: Light::InitThermalGlowPool creates eight thermal-glow light nodes, initializes their name, position, range, and pushes them onto the OptCatalog thermal glow free list.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zClass Light/OptCatalog runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b2160 validates the eight-iteration loop, zClass_Light::gwLightNew call, gwNodeSetName("Thermal glow"), gwLightSetPosition(0, 0, 0), gwLightSetRange(0.1, 0.2), callbackContext free-list push through g_OptCatalogThermalGlowFreeList, and final return value 1.

The native thermal-glow pool smoke verifies eight lights are allocated from the node free list, pushed in reverse allocation order, named Thermal glow, initialized with zero local position and range 0.1/0.2, and then cleaned up through DestroyThermalGlowPool.
